description: Exact p-value for a contingency table of counts. 2x2: Fisher exact test (two-sided, greater or less, as R fisher.test). Larger r x c tables (for example 3 variants x converted/not, or 4 x 4 survey tables): Fisher-Freeman-Halton exact test by a network algorithm. Also returns Pearson chi-square and how many cells have expected counts below 5, so you can see when the chi-square approximation is unsafe.

alternative.description: One-sided options apply to 2x2 only; greater = odds ratio above 1.

table.description: Rows of counts, for example [[12, 488], [25, 475]] (rows = groups, columns = outcomes).

name: fisher_exact_test
title: Fisher exact and Fisher-Freeman-Halton test
